v.1: Has there been a period of time for man when he was not anything worthy of mention?
v.2: Indeed We created man from the drop of a mixed fluid so that We may put him to test, so We endowed with hearing and sight.
v.3: Indeed We have guided him to the way, be he grateful or ungrateful.
v.4: Indeed for the faithless We have prepared chains, iron collars, and a blaze.
v.5: Indeed the pious will drink from a cup seasoned with Kafur,
v.6: a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, making it gush forth as they please.
v.7: They fulfill their vows and fear a day whose ill will be widespread.
v.8: For the love of Him, they feed the needy, the orphan and the prisoner,
v.9: [saying,] ‘We feed you only for the sake of Allah. We desire no reward from you, nor thanks.
v.10: Indeed we fear a frowning and fateful day from our Lord.’
v.11: So Allah saved them from that day’s ills and graced them with freshness [on this faces] and joy [in their hearts].
v.12: He rewarded them for their patience with a garden and [garments of] silk,
v.13: reclining therein on couches, without facing any [scorching] sun, or [biting] cold.
v.14: Its shades will be close over them and its clusters [of fruits] will be hanging low.
v.15: They will be served around with vessels of silver and goblets of crystal
v.16: —crystal of silver— [from] which they will dispense in a precise measure.
v.17: They will be served therein with a cup of a drink seasoned with Zanjabeel,
v.18: from a spring in it named Salsabeel.
v.19: They will be waited upon by immortal youths, whom, were you to see them, you will suppose them to be scattered pearls.
v.20: As you look on, you will see there bliss and a great kingdom.
v.21: Upon them will be cloaks of green silk and brocade and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them to drink a pure drink.
v.22: [They will be told]: ‘This is your reward, and your efforts have been well-appreciated.’
v.23: Indeed We have sent down to you the Quran in a gradual descent.
v.24: So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord and do not obey any sinner or ingrate from among them,
v.25: and celebrate the Name of your Lord morning and evening,
v.26: and worship Him for a watch of the night and glorify Him the night long.
v.27: Indeed they love this transitory life, and disregard a heavy day that is ahead of them.
v.28: We created them and strengthened their joints, and We will replace them with others like them whenever We like.
v.29: This is indeed a reminder. So let anyone who wishes take the way toward his Lord.
v.30: But you will not wish unless it is willed by Allah. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-wise.
v.31: He admits whomever He wishes into His mercy, and He has prepared a painful punishment for the wrongdoers.
